Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • A FIRE ONI WOMAN — orange flame; NOT a violet grief-hannya, and NO mask.
  • Black hair, high ponytail + auburn streak; RED horns, GOLD eyes, pale skin.
  • Black + red + gold kimono with a red peony.
  • Conjures warm orange flame. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
